title: Map the strongest time arguments and their physical assumptions
brief: Build the foundations literature lane. Read the shared seed and search log. Cover the strongest versions of presentism, eternalism, growing block, moving spotlight, and relativistic/local becoming. Follow Stein, Malament, Rietdijk/Putnam and substantive replies. Separate physical premises from ontology bridge premises; distinguish passage, determinism and causal order. Use public primary sources. Return source records and an argument dependency map, including contrary results and exact full-text locators when actually read.
done_when: Lane sources.jsonl records versions and read depth
At least four anchor arguments have premises, conclusions, objections, and source locators
Coverage gaps and a shortlist of assumptions worth computational analysis are explicit

title: Inventory reusable relativity and quantum formalizations
brief: Audit prior formal and computational work: axiomatic relativity, Isabelle, Physlib, mathlib, finite-dimensional quantum libraries, and model finding. Start with the shared source seed. Identify existing definitions and theorems, license, pinned code versions where available, and the smallest missing foundation for our candidate questions. Read code without installing dependencies or launching builds that need network. Mark unavailable inspection honestly. Propose how to check statement correspondence and transitive axioms.
done_when: Reusable-results table separates published claims from inspected code
At least three relevant projects are compared against our candidate questions
Minimal proof target and dependency/correspondence risks are recorded

title: Screen recent physics of time and identify tractable extension targets
brief: Build a broad public-source frontier map spanning causal sets, quantum clocks, Page-Wootters, thermal/relational time, QRFs, indefinite order, canonical gravity and emergent spacetime. Explicitly screen the last 90 days as of 2026-10-19 and the past year; retain older anchors. Group by theory lineage rather than paper count. Recheck recent seed papers against predecessors. Select at most five concrete recent results with equations, assumptions, open extensions and reproduction feasibility. Do not equate recency, arXiv posting, or an author claim with correctness or novelty.
done_when: Dated search log records queries, inclusions and exclusions
Theory-family comparison contract is filled for screened anchors
Up to five recent targets name nearest predecessors and tractable verification paths

title: Audit AI-assisted physics and design evidence-preserving synthesis
brief: Compare public AI-assisted physics, CAS agents, multi-agent autoformalization and semantic-audit workflows from the seed and their references. Design specialist extraction, translation, counterexample and review roles. Preserve source IDs, equations, assumptions, disagreements and failed attempts. Propose a small pilot evaluated against known papers/lemmas with deliberate incorrect translations or missing assumptions. No new agent launches or paid runs in this task.
done_when: Prior-method comparison identifies reusable code and failure modes
Structured handoff contract and semantic-audit procedure exist
Pilot has known-answer and adversarial checks; agent agreement is not its success metric

title: Synthesize a broad assumption and observable map without erasing disagreements
brief: Integrate accepted literature lanes into a model/version-level comparison graph. Track ontology, dynamics, clocks, observers, symmetries, observables and empirical status. Record proposed translations, their domains and failures. Preserve incompatible assumptions. Seek surprising bridges and precise disagreements; no weighted metaphysical truth ranking.
done_when: All included model nodes cite evidence and versions
Each proposed connection has an explicit map or is labeled conjectural
At least three candidate research contracts have testable mathematical content

title: Independently challenge proposed contributions against closest prior work
brief: Act as an independent skeptic, not the proposal author. For each candidate in the theory map, search specifically for an existing theorem, equivalence, counterexample or triviality that defeats its novelty. Compare at least three nearest predecessors at assumption/result level. Recommend one bounded primary target and one fallback, or conclude none passes yet. Do not treat absence of search hits as proof of priority.
done_when: Claim contracts meet knowledge/NOVELTY.md requirements
Existing results and rejected candidates are recorded with reasons
Chosen target has a concrete novelty delta or the gate remains explicitly unmet

title: Reproduce the selected target's smallest existing result in Python
brief: Reproduce the specific known result selected by the novelty audit using the smallest faithful model. Record equations, units, versions, seeds/tolerances and exact commands. Separate reproduced baseline from proposed extensions. Identify approximation and domain restrictions. Request dependencies through the coordinator before installation.
done_when: Baseline reproduces a named published result with explicit scope
Independent analytic or known-limit check exists
Reproduction limits and any discrepancy are recorded

title: Find a new consequence, counterexample or equivalence boundary
brief: Implement only the selected claim contract. Search changed assumptions for an unreported consequence or counterexample; check against the known baseline and nearest prior results. Preserve negative results and search bounds. Produce a precise theorem candidate or explicit countermodel and a philosophical bridge-premise audit.
done_when: Candidate has explicit assumptions and a reproducible witness or derivation
Known-result reduction and triviality checks are reported
No unbounded claim rests only on finite search

title: Verify selected mathematical claims and audit their meaning
brief: Formalize the selected precise result using existing libraries when justified. If Lean is unsuitable, document that limitation and the appropriate proof route instead of inventing a vacuous encoding. Record toolchain, dependencies, nonstandard axioms and correspondence between the encoded statement and physical claim. No sorry or opaque assumed target theorem in an accepted proof.
done_when: Proof builds reproducibly or infeasibility is explicitly reviewed
Transitive axiom and statement-correspondence audit exists
Physical/ontological interpretation is narrower than or equal to the verified statement

title: Try to break the result, its novelty and its ontological inference
brief: Independently inspect source correspondence, implementation, assumptions, proof dependencies and closest literature. Try concrete counterexamples, alternative encodings and alternative temporal interpretations. Check that novelty survives changing notation. Report findings with severity and evidence; do not edit the builder's files.
done_when: Source, numerical and formal checks are separately reported
Alternative interpretations and strongest counterarguments are addressed
Unresolved issues prevent stronger claims from being accepted

title: State what physics supports, excludes and cannot decide
brief: Write the final bounded research synthesis from integrated evidence. Distinguish established physics, reproduced results, new mathematical contribution, philosophical assumptions and empirical underdetermination. Include what would change the conclusion. A rigorous failure to discriminate is a valid result, but do not call it a novel theorem unless the audit supports that.
done_when: Every substantive claim traces to a source or verified artifact
Novel contribution is stated precisely with limitations
Open alternatives and potentially discriminating future work remain visible
